module: Drive Path Editor of the world editor: tool for drawing paths (splines) that AI vehicles follow, in free mode (hand-placed nodes, with widths and speed profile) or in navigation graph mode (choosing nodes of the map's navgraph). It also lets you record a path by driving and start playback (ai.driveUsingPath). This file is the main interface: window, mouse/keyboard input and rendering; the spline logic is in drivePathEditor/splineMgr, playback in playback and recording in record.
notes: Declared edit mode: editor.editModes.drivePathSplineEditMode ("Drive Path Spline"). On activation, the AI of all vehicles is stopped (ai.setState mode stop).
UI bounds: start delay 0 to 60 s, road speed 0 to 100 m/s, aggression 0.3 to 1.0, laps 1 to 10; displayed speed units: m/s, mph or kph (kph by default).

onEditorGui always updates "dirty" splines, even when the tool is inactive, and only draws their hulls; if the tool is active, the window is drawn, then playback/recording, otherwise the spline editor.
onSerialize serializes all splines then removes them from the scene; onDeserialized recreates them and relinks the vehicles.
The module file only exports the cross-selection (setSelectedSplineIdx/NodeIdx) and the hooks; everything else is local.

setSelectedSplineIdx.desc: Sets the selected spline (for the selection shared between tools).

setSelectedNodeIdx.desc: Sets the selected node (for the selection shared between tools).

onSerialize.desc: Save hook before extensions reload: returns the list of serialized splines and removes the splines from the scene.

onDeserialized.desc: Restore hook: recreates the splines from the data, recomputes the id-to-index table and relinks the vehicles. Does nothing if data is empty.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every frame: updates the splines, draws the window, handles playback, recording, input and rendering of free mode or navgraph mode.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook: declares the "Drive Path Spline" edit mode (traffic cone icon) and registers the window (300x700).

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called on map exit: removes all path splines, even disabled ones, to avoid invalid TSStatic pointers on the next load.
